# Live Latch Trigger

The latch trigger can now be changed while Home Assistant is running, from a dashboard or an automation, without reloading the integration.

### New
- **Latch trigger select** on every hold with a door latch: *New motion*, *Any motion* or *Doors only*. Changes apply immediately.
- **Automatable.** Set it with `select.select_option`, e.g. to use a different trigger at different times of day or in different house modes.
- **Latches on switch when it should.** If the doors are already in the latch position when the trigger changes, the hold latches straight away when the new trigger would have: *Any motion* with motion still showing, or *Doors only*.
- **Existing latches are kept.** Changing the trigger never releases a latch. It releases as before, when the doors leave the latch position or the maximum latch time is reached.

### Changed
- Changing the latch trigger in a hold's settings now applies live, without reloading the integration.

### Upgrade notes
- Nothing to reconfigure. The select appears on every hold with a door latch, set to the trigger already chosen.
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/Hold-Latch/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0
